How many years' experience do you have as a draftsperson?
content_text:
Architect /Draftsperson | Progetto Design
Location: Adelaide, SA
Employment Type: Full-Time
Experience: 5 + Years
About Progetto Design
At Progetto Design, we specialise in commercial and residential design with a strong focus on furniture design and selection, creating tailored spaces that blend beauty, functionality, and craftsmanship.
Our work brings together the best of locally made custom joinery and Italian-imported furniture to deliver interiors that are both refined and practical. We collaborate with trusted manufacturers and skilled artisans to ensure every detail aligns with our clients’ lifestyle and vision.
Whether it’s a bespoke kitchen, a custom wardrobe, or a full home interior solution, our approach is hands-on and personal – from concept through to completion. At Progetto Design, every project is a partnership, and every space is a reflection of thoughtful design.
The Opportunity
Due to continued growth, we are seeking an experienced architect or Draftsperson with 5 years' experience in commercial and domestic documentation to join our team.
Key Responsibilities
- Prepare detailed documentation, shop drawings, and construction drawings for commercial and interior fit-out projects.
- Develop plans, elevations, sections, and technical details.
- Coordinate with designers, consultants, builders, and suppliers.
- Ensure drawings comply with relevant Australian standards and project requirements.
- Assist with project documentation throughout the design and construction process.
- Conduct site measurements and verify project dimensions where required.
- Support design development and documentation using CAD software.
About You
You will be detail-oriented, technically skilled, and passionate about quality design.
To be successful, you will have:
- 5 years' experience as a architect /Draftsperson commercial or domestic experience.
- Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD (essential).
- Strong understanding of construction methodologies and detailing.
- Ability to read and interpret architectural drawings and specifications.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
Desirable:
- Experience with SketchUp, Revit, or other 3D modelling software.
- Knowledge of custom joinery manufacturing processes.
Why Join Progetto Design?
- Work on unique, design-focused projects.
- Collaborate with a passionate and creative team.
- Exposure to premium Australian-made joinery and Italian furniture brands.
- Opportunity for professional growth and development.
- Supportive and collaborative workplace culture.
- Be part of creating beautifully crafted spaces that genuinely enhance how people live and work.
Apply Now
If you are passionate about exceptional design, technical excellence, and bringing creative concepts to life, we'd love to hear from you.
Submit your resume and portfolio showcasing your project experience and technical documentation capabilities to applynow@thehrroom.com.au
